  • Constructor Details

    • CoupledProcessEnergyResult

      public CoupledProcessEnergyResult(boolean converged, CoupledProcessEnergyResult.TerminationReason terminationReason, int iterations, double maximumProcessResidual, double maximumPowerResidual, List<CoupledProcessEnergyResult.IterationResult> iterationHistory, List<EnergyNetworkReport> energyReports)
      Creates a coupled convergence result.
      Parameters:
      converged - whether all configured tolerances were satisfied
      terminationReason - reason why iteration stopped
      iterations - number of completed process runs
      maximumProcessResidual - final maximum relative stream-state change
      maximumPowerResidual - final maximum absolute energy-network change in W
      iterationHistory - diagnostics for all completed iterations
      energyReports - reports from the final energy-network solution
